messages.subject: absolute jacobian determinant for LL'
parts:
Hello stan users

following is part of my model 

parameters{

cholesky_factor_cov[3] chol_v;

}
transformed parameters{

cov_matrix[3] v;

v <- tcrossprod(chol_v);

}
model{

v ~ inv_wishart(nu,Sigma);

}

I would like to add the increment_log_prob after v for the absolute jacobian determinant, so is there any command for calculating the derivative of the form of LL' with respect to L? 
Thanks

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: absolute jacobian determinant for LL'
parts:
On Friday, March 18, 2016 at 3:30:32 PM UTC-4, Liang Chen wrote:
I would like to add the increment_log_prob after v for the absolute jacobian determinant, so is there any command for calculating the derivative of the form of LL' with respect to L?
No, all log absolute Jacobian determinants have to be worked out analytically.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] absolute jacobian determinant for LL'
parts:
I'd recommend replacing the Wishart with a scaled LKJ
prior. See Ben's paper:

http://andrewgelman.com/2012/08/30/visualizing-distributions-of-covariance-matrices/

What we really need is a Cholesky-parameterized (inverse)
Wishart with the Jacobian baked in, the way Ben set up
the LKJ priors. The full derivation of the Jacobians required
is in the manual chapter on the underlying transforms (near
the end of the manual).

- Bob
